subject: Error: C stack usage  15925384 is too close to the limit

messages.author: 493d695f0e28df7a
messages.subject: Error: C stack usage  15925384 is too close to the limit
parts:
In an attempt to plot ancestral reconstruction pie charts on my huge phylogenetic tree (10500 taxa), I keep getting the following error:

"Error: C stack usage  15925384 is too close to the limit"

How to fix it? And why is this happening?

messages.author: fa1e85b72b50d60b
messages.subject: Re: Error: C stack usage 15925384 is too close to the limit
parts:
Maybe you could try setting memory limits.
https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/base/html/Memory-limits.html  

For example, on a  windows 10 PC  with 16GB of physical memory
memory.limit(size = 20000) is ok
https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/utils/html/memory.size.html  

This error is not usually caused by a lack of memory space. The above settings may not solve the problem.
The following example uses a much larger volume of data, but no errors were reported.
n = 2000000
testdata <- data.frame(
  a <- c(runif(n, min = 0, max = 1)),
  b <- c(runif(n, min = 0, max = 1)),
  node <- seq(1:20000)
)
colnames(testdata)  <- c("a","b","node")
bars <- nodebar(testdata, cols=1:2)

I'd suggest checking for problems with data or function usage.
